scoring_justification: Primary numeric quantities (entropy, smooth H_diff, S_diff) are compared to the paper's reported values within tolerances; transition is confirmed by a structural derivative peak check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for entropy and heat-content table from the original paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III and reported standard entropy S°298.16 = 18.73 ± 0.15 cal/(deg·mole).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values were transcribed exactly from the paper's published numerical results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published results that a genuine reproduction must match; they are not invented by the verifier.

schema.description: Single floating-point number representing S°298.16 in cal/(deg·mole).

outputs.description: Standard entropy at 298.16 K derived from low-temperature heat capacity data.

schema.description: Rows for T = 350, 400, 420, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000. 420 K row carries the phase-transition values.

outputs.description: Smoothed heat content and entropy increments above 298.16 K, obtained from fitted high-temperature equations.

output_contract.notes: The low-temperature extrapolation may use any reasonable method; exact Debye–Einstein function is not required. Only the smooth table values are scored, not the fitted polynomial coefficients.
